title: Jubilee Vessel of Pepi I
acquisition: Public rendered museum object page; inscription and metadata fields only. Longer description excluded.
text: The Horus, Mery-tawy (Beloved of the Two Lands); King of Upper and Lower Egypt, Mery-re (Beloved of Re); First occasion of the Sed-festival; Given life and dominion forever, given life and dominion forever
alternative_translation: Right column: "First of the Sed Festival" Middle column: "King of Upper and Lower Egypt", Mery-Ra Left column: "Horus name=Mery-tawy"; Horizontally " Given life and happiness forever" (this twice)
geography: Egypt, Saqqara (Place of Origin); Egypt (Place of Discovery)
provenance: Dikran Kelekian, Paris and New York, [date and mode of acquisition unknown]; Henry Walters, Baltimore, 1914, by purchase; Walters Art Museum, 1931, by bequest.
coverage_evidence: The museum inscription field renders all three labelled columns and the repeated horizontal blessing. Its second rendering is preserved as an alternative, not counted as another inscription.
visual_observation: 1620×1800 museum photograph: vessel and framed inscription panel visible, dark signs contrast with pale stone; some wear and fading. One view only; no reviewed sign alignment.
rights_scope: Walters image and metadata CC0 policy. Longer descriptive text has separate GFDL terms and is not imported.
